data.name: Open Forest Protocol
data.description: Open Forest Protocol (Open Forest AG) is a Swiss-based, blockchain-powered MRV and registry platform for nature-based carbon credits, primarily afforestation and reforestation projects. It does not itself remove CO2; instead it digitizes project registration, coordinates a network of expert validators using satellite, AI and LIDAR data, and issues on-chain credits. The company collaborates with forest projects across roughly 20 countries.
